rationale: VERSION 1.2.0 -> 3.0.0: removed the non-square-only random connected motif hack and replaced it with arbitrary sparse square or rectangular colored crops.; Added all five exact linked public canvas/command/motif profiles with motif translation as the sole quotient.; Added all 36 ordered command pairs, including identity, over motif heights/widths 2..5 and exact two/three-color support.; Calibrated the exact-profile prior from 8% to 6% and expanded easy motifs to 2..4 so every final 5000-draw output cell exceeds 93% diversity without sacrificing substantive public coverage.; Reduced AXES to seven honest returned-grid facts: canvas height/width, motif height/width, color count, and both ordered commands.; Removed four dead helpful textures, palette aliases, fixed motifs, position_bias/cmd_diversity no-ops, and no-motif/invalid-command/no-command degenerates.; Added strict unknown/type/range validation, exact GenCtx draws, observe_overrides, canonical_profile_signature, is_canonical_profile, rule_mirror, and structural self_check.; Added eight focused regression groups covering every public pair, profile stability, all 36 command pairs, every boundary, exact provenance, checker mutations, noncommutative recombination, and RNG/fresh-return isolation.; Pinned RULE_HASH=9f952248bd5f and synchronized the base target authority to canonical executable source.
summary: Read transform commands from (0,0) and (0,1), clear those two cells, crop all remaining nonzero content, apply command one to that crop, then apply command two to the intermediate grid. Commands are 0 identity, 1 clockwise rotation, 2 half-turn, 3 transpose, 4 left-right flip, and 5 up-down flip.
